eggs.name: Title egg
eggs.design: Hit the egg on the title screen ten times.
eggs.reward: A tiny hatchling climbs out and waddles off screen.

eggs.name: Crown of the Hill
eggs.design: A golden relic on a ledge you can only reach by jumping.
eggs.reward: The Crown of the Hill relic card (relic-12) and a brass glint on your ring for the match.

eggs.name: Hill alone
eggs.design: Hold the hill alone for sixty seconds with no ally on it.
eggs.line: Still up there on your own? Respect.

eggs.name: Exact tie
eggs.design: Allegiance exactly tied at the hatch.
eggs.reward: The neutral outro shows the hatchling shrugging on the hill.
eggs.line: The Kaiju chose no one, and sat down on the hill to think about it.

eggs.name: Credits gag
eggs.design: The last line of the credits.
eggs.reward: A line under the final credit, then the hatchling looks at the camera.
eggs.line: No Kaiju were overfed in the making of this game. One was slightly corrupted.
